name: Survey tile in Scorpius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Scorpius, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 5 visits over 47 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.0 days starting 2026-03-02, at wavelengths from 1.66 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
